Clustered mushrooms with smooth, moist, light brown caps showing irregular, lobed margins. Gills beneath are pale to light brown. Stems are slender, white to pale, and smooth, with some soil at the base. Caps appear slightly ruffled and convex.

Small, pale yellow fruiting body with a smooth, slightly translucent, waxy surface. Irregular, somewhat lobed shape with an even, unornamented margin. Compact and stalkless, appearing moist and cartilaginous.
Green leaves display scattered, small, irregular brownish spots blending subtly with the smooth leaf surface. No visible fruiting bodies or distinct fungal structures are apparent at this distance.

Four mushrooms with smooth, moist, light brown convex to slightly flattened caps, pale yellowish to cream closely spaced gills, and thick, robust pale stipes showing brownish discoloration and soil at the base. Caps have subtle, paler margins.

Green leaves and stems display scattered, irregular white patches and streaks, with a fine, powdery or downy coating. Affected foliage appears curled, distorted, and slightly yellowed, with the white growth concentrated along upper surfaces and stems.

Mushroom with a round, cream-colored cap densely covered in brown, spiny or wart-like scales, especially at the center forming a prominent disc. The cap margin is slightly fringed, and the stem is white and slender.

Mushrooms with convex to slightly depressed, light brown to grayish-brown caps showing faint radial striations. Gills are crowded, pale cream to off-white. Slender, white to pale gray stems, some with soil at the base. No visible ring or annulus.
Numerous small, black, roughly spherical to angular bumps scattered irregularly across a pale, smooth, shiny stem. The bumps are matte to slightly glossy and appear partially embedded in the surface.
Large, smooth, white hemispherical cap with a firm, thick margin. Cap and thick white stem are partially covered in soil. Partial veil remnants encircle the upper stem; base volva is mostly obscured.

Irregular, patchy white growth with a fuzzy, powdery texture covers parts of the green leaf, following veins and margins. The white areas are thin, unevenly distributed, and granular, with some leaf edges appearing torn or frayed.

Irregular, crusty patch with a pale whitish-gray color and a cracked, granular surface. Small, rounded whitish structures are embedded in the surface. The margin is diffuse, blending into the background, and the texture appears tightly appressed.

Irregular, lobed clusters with a semi-translucent, gelatinous texture. Surface is moist, glistening, and pale whitish-gray, with rounded, undulate margins. Small dark inclusions or debris are scattered on the compact, closely grouped lobes.

Pale, intricately branched, fruticose structure with thin, flattened, irregular lobes. The surface is whitish to grayish with scattered blackish speckles, giving a delicate, slightly roughened appearance.

Minute, irregularly shaped fruiting bodies with a granular, crystalline surface and uneven margins. Distinctive blue-green coloration, scattered and somewhat clustered on a fibrous substrate. Individual bodies vary slightly in size and shape, giving a textured appearance.

A brown, sunken lesion with a cracked, dried texture runs along the stem and leaf base, sharply demarcated from surrounding green tissue. The lesion displays granular or powdery structures, with minor leaf spotting and curling nearby.

Small mushroom with a tan to light brown cap, densely covered in rough, dark, raised scales and irregular, wavy margins. The slender, curved stem is partially obscured by soil. Cap diameter is about 3–4 cm.

Large, robust fruiting bodies with smooth, bright white, convex to globose caps. Some caps have adhering soil and minor brown debris. One specimen shows significant surface damage. Thick, white stipe with a bulbous base, partially covered in soil.

Cluster of four mushrooms with slender, white, fibrous stems and medium brown, convex to hemispherical caps with a fine, velvety surface. Two mushrooms show closely spaced, pale to medium brown gills. Cap margins are even, and soil clings to the lower stems.

Tiny, greenish-blue, cup-shaped structures scattered and loosely clustered on the surface, each with a granular to velvety texture and thin, even margins. The fruiting bodies are minute, circular to slightly irregular, and closely appressed to the substrate.
Delicate mushroom with a thin, elongated pale stem and closely spaced, light brown gills radiating from the center. The cap surface is not visible, highlighting the fine gill structure beneath.

Cluster of small mushrooms with long, slender reddish-brown stems and conical to bell-shaped brown caps featuring a pronounced central bump and striate, wavy margins. Brownish gills are visible beneath the caps.

Convex, smooth light brown cap with a moist, slightly glossy surface. Irregular white patches and two prominent holes are visible, along with some adhering soil and organic debris. The stipe and gills are not visible.

Dense clusters of small, rounded, whitish to grayish globular fruiting bodies with a powdery texture, scattered irregularly across decaying plant material. The sporocarps are closely packed, forming granular patches that contrast with the muted browns of the substrate.

Numerous tiny, scattered, greenish-blue cup- or disc-shaped fruiting bodies with smooth to slightly undulating margins, irregularly grouped across a fibrous surface. The apothecia are minute and display a vivid blue-green coloration.

Numerous tiny, blue-green cup-shaped discs with slightly raised, undulate margins and a granular or velvety texture, densely scattered and clustered across the surface. The fruiting bodies are circular to irregular, creating a textured, colorful pattern.

Numerous tiny, greenish-blue, cup-shaped structures with smooth, rounded edges are scattered in clusters along a fibrous, decaying stem. The minute cups have a somewhat translucent to opaque texture and vary in size, creating a textured, irregular pattern.

Dense, irregular patch of small, cushion-like fruiting bodies, dark gray to nearly black, with a granular to warty surface. The rough texture and diffuse margins blend gradually into the wood substrate.

Dense, fuzzy, cottony patches of greenish-blue mold form irregular, powdery clumps across a yellowish background. The colonies are rounded, merging into larger areas with diffuse, gradually blending margins.

Three mushrooms with convex to flat caps, fibrous and scaly surfaces, darker brown centers fading to orange-brown margins, striate edges, crowded ochre-yellow gills, and slender, finely fibrillose stems, one slightly bulbous at the base.
A flat patch with a white, cottony surface merging into a brown, bristly, spiny-textured area. The margin is irregular, and the fungus lies closely pressed against the wood.
No visible fungal structures or signs are present; only green leaves, stems, and a small yellow-flowered plant are seen among grass.

Small, translucent to pale, irregularly shaped structures with a granular appearance, scattered with numerous minute dark dots. The surface looks moist and slightly reflective, with closely grouped clusters and no distinct margins or edges.

A tiny, delicate mushroom with a light brown, conical to bell-shaped cap. The cap is distinctly striate and slightly translucent at the margin. The slender, pale stipe is mostly hidden among fibrous plant debris.

Clustered mushrooms with convex to flattened, light to dark brown caps showing a fibrillose to scaly texture and fringed margins. Stems are slender, pale yellowish to whitish, and gills are closely spaced and pale yellow. Some caps display a darker center.

Small, vivid yellow cup-shaped fruiting body with a distinctly white, fuzzy, and irregularly fringed margin. The outer surface is covered in fine, hair-like structures, giving a cottony texture. The margin forms a sharp contrast against the bright interior.
Circular lesion with a grayish-brown, powdery texture and a darker, irregular border. The center is lighter and perforated, with diffuse margins blending into the green leaf tissue.

Cluster of mushrooms with convex to slightly depressed caps, ochre to brown with darker centers and faint radial streaks. Caps have smooth, dry surfaces and even margins. Gills are broad, pale ochre, and moderately spaced. Stems are robust, pale cream to yellowish, with brownish stains and soil at the base.

Small, cushion-shaped fruiting bodies with a whitish-grey, granular or powdery surface, clustered in a linear arrangement. Margins are rounded and slightly irregular, with compact, discrete structures visible against the substrate.

Dark brown, glossy caps with a pronounced central umbo and moist, shiny surfaces. Cap margins are wavy and irregular. Stems are long, slender, fibrous, and dark brown, with a slight curvature. Brown, closely spaced gills are visible on some specimens.

Dense clusters of short, upright, cream to pale brown spines cover the central area, transitioning sharply to a white, cottony, spreading margin. The spiny surface appears bristly and tightly packed, contrasting with the soft, fluffy texture at the edges.

Cluster of mushrooms with convex to conical, moist, glossy brown caps featuring a dark central umbo and paler, striate margins. Long, slender, dark brown stems emerge from soil among pine needles and moss. Gills are not visible.

A small, dark, rounded to slightly domed structure with a smooth, somewhat shiny surface, surrounded by a diffuse black zone. The margin is indistinct, blending into the surrounding blackened area on a light brown, smooth background.
Slender white stem supporting a brown cap with irregular, frilly margin. Distinctive white, hair-like tufts are scattered along the cap edge. Gills beneath are closely spaced and pale to brownish.

Light brown cap with a rough, scaly surface and darker patches; white, closely spaced gills free from the stem. The stem is light brown with darker fibrous patches and a soil-covered base. Cap margin slightly uplifted.

Two slender mushrooms with fragile, elongated pale brown stems and smooth, conical to bell-shaped tan caps. The caps show pronounced radial striations along the margin. Underside reveals crowded, light brown gills. Surface appears smooth and moist.

Cluster of five mushrooms with long, slender, reddish-brown, sinuous stems. Caps are conical to broadly convex, rusty to reddish-brown, with pronounced radial striations and wavy, irregular edges. Gills underneath are closely spaced and match the cap color.

Tiny, cup-shaped fruiting bodies with vivid yellow centers and dense, white, hair-like fringes. One appears more uniformly white and slightly fused. Margins are distinctly hairy, giving a delicate, finely tomentose texture.

Delicate mushrooms with convex, smooth, moist caps ranging from pale tan to medium brown, some showing darker centers and faint zonation. Striate margins are visible. Slender, white stems support crowded, grayish-brown gills. Fruit bodies are loosely clustered among green leaves and leaf litter.

Large, thick white fruiting body with a smooth, convex cap showing a faint cream tinge. The stem is robust and solid, ending in a prominent, sac-like volva at the base, partially covered with soil. Cap margin is even and unbroken.

Close-up of a cup-shaped structure with a smooth, matte orange surface and a distinctly thickened, reddish-brown margin. The edge is minutely ridged or papillate, sharply contrasting with the inner surface. Small debris is scattered across the surface.
Irregular, pale whitish lesion with a granular surface, sharply bordered by a brownish-red margin on a green leaf. The spot is flat and lacks raised or cottony structures.

Small, tan to light brown fruiting bodies with irregular, convoluted, and lobed caps. Surfaces appear moist and slightly translucent. Stipes are thin and pale, supporting the caps above dense green moss. Caps vary from globose to distorted or folded, with a smooth texture.

Mushroom with a pale tan to yellowish-brown, nearly flat cap and closely spaced light brown gills. The robust, yellowish stem has brownish fibrils and a distinctly bulbous base with adhering soil and mycelial threads.

Large, thick white stem with soil at the base, supporting a substantial, convex white cap with a smooth surface and slightly irregular margin. White, closely spaced gills are visible at the cap’s edge. The mushroom appears fleshy and robust.
Irregular, patchy crust with dense, downward-pointing spines. Colors range from tan and ochre to whitish, with a fibrous, spiny texture and diffuse, uneven margins blending into the substrate.

Three mushrooms with convex to bell-shaped caps in yellowish to orange-brown hues, dry and smooth. Cylindrical, moderately robust stems show lighter streaks and some adhering debris. Cap margins are slightly inrolled, and the texture appears dry and fibrous, especially on the stems.

Tiny, greenish-blue, disc-shaped to rosette-like fruiting bodies with smooth to slightly granular surfaces and faintly scalloped margins, closely grouped and flat to slightly cup-shaped, scattered across the brown stem.
Tiny, rounded blue-green discs with smooth surfaces are scattered in a line along the dark midrib of a decaying leaf, standing out vividly against the brown and black background.

A small, compact, black mass with a distinctly bumpy and irregular surface, composed of aggregated, minute, globular or irregularly shaped bodies. The texture appears rough and granular against the woody substrate.

Tiny, round, blue-green discs with a smooth, waxy surface are scattered along a slender, dark stem. The discs are flat to slightly convex, have well-defined margins, and measure only a few millimeters across.
A solitary fruiting body with a long, slender, grayish-blue stem covered in fine, hair-like setules and a small, white, convex cap adorned with delicate, fuzzy hairs along the margin.

A small, black, crust-like patch with a rough, granular surface and irregular, indistinct margins blending into the substrate. The structure is tightly adherent and lacks visible fruiting bodies or spore masses at this magnification.

A single, slender fruiting body with a long, thin, pale stalk and a small, rounded cap. The cap is pale and distinctly covered in fine, hair-like structures, giving it a fuzzy texture. The margin is even.

Small, gelatinous fruiting bodies with smooth, irregularly shaped caps in translucent tan to light brown. Caps appear moist and shiny, some slightly lobed. Slender, pale to light brown stems support the caps above dense green moss. Texture is moist and rubbery.

Cluster of small, rounded, nearly black structures with a rough, granular surface, interspersed with a few minute, reddish-orange fruiting bodies. The surface appears uneven and slightly glossy, with no distinct margin.

Slender, pale brown stems support small, irregularly rounded caps with a gelatinous, moist texture. The caps are pale tan to yellowish, with uneven, wavy margins and a translucent appearance. Fruiting bodies are scattered and slightly curved.

Minute, nearly transparent to whitish, globose to irregular fruiting bodies with glistening, moist surfaces. Each contains conspicuous dark granular material inside. The structures are closely clustered and embedded in a moist, particulate matrix.

Smooth, pale brown cap with scattered white patches and striate margin. White, slender stem with a skirt-like ring near the top and a slightly bulbous, soil-covered base. White gills visible from the side.

Green leaflets display irregular, pale whitish to light tan patches and spots with indistinct margins scattered across the surface. The lesions are angular to irregular in shape and distributed unevenly on the leaf tissue.
Scattered small, irregular, gelatinous patches that are translucent to whitish, blending into the bark. The fruitbodies appear soft, moist, and amorphous, lacking any defined shape or structure.

A single, delicate mushroom with a long, slender, pale stipe and a small, rounded grayish-brown cap. The cap surface appears finely textured or minutely hairy, and the overall stature is fragile and graceful.

Medium-sized mushrooms with convex to nearly flat, light yellowish-brown caps, some with darker centers and scattered debris. Caps are dry and finely fibrillose. Gills are pale and closely spaced. Stipes are robust, cylindrical, and pale yellowish to cream, with soil at the base.

Small, conical to bell-shaped light brown caps with distinctly grooved margins. Caps are smooth and slightly translucent at the edges. Slender, elongated, pale cream stems and closely spaced gills are visible beneath the caps.

Solitary mushroom with a pale brownish-gray, smooth, slightly flattened cap bearing scattered white patches. The cap margin is striate, gills are white and closely spaced. The tall, slender white stipe has a persistent membranous volva at the base.

Small, circular fruitbodies with conspicuous white, cottony margins encircle yellow-orange discs. The margins are distinctly hairy, giving a flower-like appearance. The fruitbodies are clustered and stand out against the dark, moist background.

Broad, convex cap with a smooth, velvety surface. The center is dark brown, fading to pale yellow at the margin. The margin is smooth and slightly incurved, with scattered brownish spots and minor debris on the surface.

A single, shallow, cup-shaped structure with a vivid orange, smooth, and slightly glossy surface. The margin is well-defined, forming a darker, distinct rim. The cup is thin-walled, sessile, and unlobed, with a few small debris particles on the surface.

A dark, nearly black, crust-like patch tightly adheres to the surface, with a granular, minutely cracked texture and a matte, slightly roughened appearance. The margin is diffuse, blending irregularly into the exposed wood and bark.

Numerous elongated, dark brown to blackish streaks and pustules densely line the lower surfaces and veins of the light green, pinnately lobed leaves, extending onto the stem and disrupting the normal leaf coloration.

Dense, greenish-blue fuzzy patches form irregular, powdery colonies with a granular, velvety texture. Numerous small, rounded tufts are unevenly distributed, creating areas of concentrated growth against a yellowish background.

Delicate mushroom with a slender, pale brown stem and a conical to bell-shaped, light brown cap. The cap is smooth with faint radial striations near the margin and a slightly darker center. Gills are closely spaced beneath the cap.

Numerous tiny, black, raised dot-like structures scattered irregularly across a dry, light brown, fibrous stem. Each dot appears as a minute, rounded, slightly protruding black spot. The stem surface is rough and weathered, with no visible mats or crusts.

Dense, short, pale to light tan spine-like projections cover a spreading patch, bordered by a conspicuous cottony white margin. The central area appears bristly, while the edges are soft and fibrous, tightly appressed to the substrate.
Patchy, resupinate growth with dense, short, crowded spines in white, cream, and tan hues. The surface appears irregular and hydnoid, with diffuse, cottony margins and embedded woody debris.

Tiny, cup-shaped fruiting body with a vivid orange center and a prominent, white, cottony, finely hairy margin. The delicate structure stands out against the background, with scattered, similarly textured fruiting bodies nearby.
Tiny, rounded fruiting bodies with a bright yellow-orange central disc and a finely fringed white margin, scattered across moist, textured wood.
Numerous tiny, disc-shaped fruitbodies with smooth, bluish-gray centers and distinct whitish margins, appearing translucent and clustered closely together on a dried, fibrous stem.

Two small, cup-shaped fruiting bodies with bright yellow, smooth interiors and distinctly white, densely hairy margins. The cups are closely grouped, appearing nearly sessile, with a woolly or cottony edge.

Minute, irregular dark brown to nearly black patches scattered on a pale, textured surface with greenish and yellowish mottling. Some spots are slightly raised and granular, with two distinct dark aggregations visible.
Reddish-brown, glossy, and textured surface with scattered small, black, rounded structures embedded or slightly raised above the surface, creating a speckled appearance.

Clustered mushrooms with smooth, convex to slightly depressed light brown to grayish caps, some with inrolled margins. Stems are short, white to pale cream, and cylindrical. Gills are pale cream and moderately crowded. Surfaces appear smooth and moist.

Two mushrooms with convex, pale yellow to cream caps showing brownish discoloration and subtle fibrillose texture. Gills are closely spaced and light tan. Stems are robust, yellowish with brown stains, fibrous, and have soil and veil remnants at the base.

Cluster of slender, upright mushrooms with elongated beige to light brown stems, some showing darker streaks. Caps are rounded to irregular, light to medium brown, with wavy, uneven margins and a slightly textured surface.

Pale grayish-white crust with a rough, cracked, and uneven surface. The patchy thallus is mostly flat to slightly undulating, featuring fine fissures and granular areas, lacking visible reproductive structures.

Pale, smooth cap with faint radial striations and a few white veil remnants. Free, closely spaced gills beneath. Slender white stipe with a skirt-like ring and bulbous base partially encased in a volva. Grows upright from grassy soil.
Microscopic view shows a thin section with a central, rounded, brownish structure featuring a subtly textured surface, embedded in a paler, irregular matrix with uneven margins.

Numerous small, irregular, translucent to whitish gelatinous patches scattered across bark. The fruiting bodies are soft, moist, and lobed or amorphous, with a smooth, jelly-like texture and variable size.

Irregular, pale, powdery patch with a diffuse margin and off-white to tan coloration, slightly raised and matte compared to the surrounding green leaf surface. No distinct fruiting bodies are visible.

Dense, powdery white growth covers much of the lemon’s surface, with a central patch of blue-green coloration. The colony has an irregular, diffuse margin blending into the yellow skin, forming a single expansive patch.

Elongated, black, slit-like fruiting bodies embedded in a reddish-brown needle, with dark margins and a dry, smooth surface. The apothecia are slightly raised and aligned parallel to the needle's long axis, standing out against the background.

Mature mushroom with a convex, pale brown cap densely covered in coarse brown scales. White, crowded gills radiate from a thick, fibrous stipe, which is also adorned with scattered brownish scales. One specimen is broken, revealing its internal structure.

Dense cluster of thin, flattened, contorted branches in pale greenish-yellow, bearing numerous disc- to cup-shaped apothecia with pale centers and darker brownish margins. Branches are upright, bushy, and slightly wrinkled, with some apothecia showing granular or spotted surfaces.

Clustered, thin, ear- to cup-shaped fruitbodies with irregular, split or lobed margins. Outer surface is dull brown and finely velvety; inner surface is lighter brown to tan and moist. Margins are uneven and wavy, giving a delicate appearance.

Loosely tufted, slender, greenish-gray branches with a slightly roughened surface. Numerous small, rounded, pale disks are scattered along the irregularly dichotomous, somewhat flattened branches. The texture appears brittle and dry.

Irregular, lobed mass with a rough, uneven surface. The upper side is covered in convoluted, pale to olive-greenish patches and ridges, giving a crust-like, fibrous appearance. Margins are uneven and indistinct.

Sharply defined, sunken lesion with a pale brown to gray, papery center showing superficial cracking. Surrounded by a dark brown to black margin and a faint yellowish halo, following the leaf veins. No visible fruiting bodies.

Broad, convex to flat caps with dark brown, coarse, patchy scales, especially at the center. Cap margins are irregular and ragged. White, closely spaced gills and long, cylindrical stems with brownish, fibrous surfaces and slightly bulbous bases.
Numerous tiny, pale yellow cup-shaped structures densely cover the stem, each with a fringe of fine, hair-like filaments around the margin and a slightly granular inner surface.

Smooth, vibrant orange cap emerging from a large, white, sac-like volva. One specimen is cut to reveal thick white flesh, yellowish margin, and closely packed gills. The cap is egg-shaped to hemispherical in the young stage.

Green leaves display irregular, diffuse patches of bright white, powdery coating. The fungal growth appears as a fine, powdery layer covering significant portions of the leaf surfaces, contrasting sharply with the green background. Some leaves show areas of browning or necrosis.

Crustose patch tightly attached to rock, with a cracked, areolate surface in pale gray, off-white, and yellowish-brown tones. Numerous small, black, rounded dots are scattered across, giving a speckled appearance. Margins are irregular and blend into the stone.

Numerous small, yellowish-brown, slightly raised pustules scattered and clustered across the green leaf surface, giving a powdery to granular texture. The pustules are irregularly distributed and contrast with the prominent veins and serrated leaf edges.

Medium to dark brown convex cap with prominent spiky to scaly protrusions, irregular uplifted margin. Underside shows closely spaced, pale cream gills free from the robust, fibrous, off-white to pale brownish stem with remnants of a partial veil.

Clustered mushrooms with smooth, pale off-white to light tan caps, some convex and others nearly flat with slight central depressions and irregular margins. Stems are slender, pale, and slightly fibrous, tapering at the base. Caps show minor blemishes and scattered debris.

Gelatinous, translucent to whitish mass with a bluish-gray hue, featuring a moist, glistening surface covered in small, rounded, blister-like swellings and irregular bumpy ridges spreading thinly over the substrate.

Tiny, circular, white to cream fruiting bodies with conspicuous, fine, hair-like fringes along the margins. The surface appears velvety and fuzzy, and the fruiting bodies are clustered on a brown, textured background.

Compact, rounded fruiting bodies with a pale, yellowish to light brown, irregularly lobed and warty exterior. The cut specimen reveals a marbled interior of intricate white veins against a darker background. Surface appears rough with soil remnants.

Cluster of small, rounded to irregularly lobed fruiting bodies with bright yellowish-orange color and subtly net-like, slightly glossy surface. Margins are even, and some diffuse brownish areas are visible. The fruiting bodies are closely grouped together.

Clustered, thin-walled cup-shaped bodies with irregular, split or lobed margins. Outer surface is dark brown to grayish-brown, inner surface is paler tan. Texture appears smooth, and cups are closely grouped together.
Dense white, powdery mycelium forms a loose, web-like mat scattered with numerous small, dark brown to black, nearly spherical, slightly raised structures on a greenish background.

Elongated brown plant structures display irregular, dark brown to blackish mottled lesions with scattered lighter tan patches. The lesions are smooth, superficial, and lack prominent fruiting bodies or raised structures, appearing as irregular surface discoloration.
Cup-shaped fruiting body with a deep split along one side, outer surface pale brown to grayish and slightly granular, inner surface smooth and yellowish, margin irregular and undulate.

Numerous small, rounded to irregular, yellowish-orange fruiting bodies with a smooth, glossy, cushion-like texture are scattered in loose clusters across a dark, moist woody surface. Some bodies coalesce into larger masses, creating a vibrant contrast against the background.

Small, nearly black, roughly spherical to irregular fruiting bodies with a granular, slightly roughened surface, clustered together among pale, granular material. Margins are indistinct and the overall size is minute.

Leaves display a patchy, diffuse whitish powdery coating on their upper surfaces, giving a dusty appearance. Some leaf edges show slight yellowing or browning. No distinct fruiting bodies are visible.

Clustered, rounded structures with a distinctly bumpy, pitted surface. Pale yellow to cream coloration, with an orange tinge in the center of one cluster. Irregularly lobed and tightly grouped, appearing moist.

Several tiny, pale yellowish to translucent disc-shaped bodies with smooth, rounded margins are scattered across a moist, brownish, woody surface. The discs appear gelatinous and slightly shiny, grouped irregularly on the substrate.

Irregular, crust-like layer with a patchy, granular to slightly woolly surface. Predominantly grayish-blue to bluish-green, interspersed with lighter and yellowish patches. Thin, spreading mat with embedded plant debris and no visible cap or stem.

Numerous minute, brown to dark brown, irregularly rounded to cup-like fruiting bodies densely clustered and covered with fine, hair-like structures. The surface appears rough and appressed to the substrate, with indistinct margins blending into the background.

Robust mushroom with a thick, dark brown cylindrical stem and a paler, slightly bulbous base. The underside reveals closely spaced, cream-colored gills with brownish spots and minor irregularities. Cap surface is not visible.

Dense clusters of small, dark brown to nearly black thalli with a crumpled, folded surface. The texture is granular and warty, with irregular, overlapping lobes and uneven, curled margins. Some areas display a slight sheen.

Small, irregular cream to pale tan colonies with uneven, lobed margins and conspicuous dark brown to blackish spots scattered across granular, warted surfaces. Some colonies cluster or merge, dotting the woody substrate.

Extensive, creamy white to pale yellow patch with a lumpy, cerebriform surface. The texture is bumpy and irregular, with a diffuse margin blending into the substrate. Scattered greenish fragments are present on and around the soft, spreading crust.
A linear cluster of small, dark, nearly spherical to irregular structures with a granular, slightly fuzzy texture, closely packed along a pale surface.

Whitish to pale cream, crust-like layer with a granular, uneven surface densely covered in small, rounded, warty pustules. The margin is diffuse and blends into the substrate, with scattered dark flecks and debris across the surface.

Green lobed leaf covered with numerous small, scattered yellow-orange pustules and spots. Some areas show pale, irregular necrotic patches. The affected regions appear slightly raised and granular, contrasting with the smoother, healthy leaf tissue.

Irregular, patchy colonies with greenish and whitish coloration spread thinly across the wood surface. The texture appears powdery to granular, with diffuse, indistinct margins blending into the substrate. No prominent fruiting bodies are visible.

Dense clusters of small, dark brown to black, circular discs sit atop a rough, granular, and uneven surface. The discs are slightly raised, well-defined, and closely packed, with a somewhat glossy appearance and occasional lighter patches scattered throughout.

A small, compact dark central structure with numerous fine, hair-like filaments radiating outward, forming a wispy, tufted, bristly appearance. The filaments are pale gray to nearly translucent, giving the fungus a delicate, fuzzy look.

Slender, upright stalks topped with small, whitish, powdery, globose heads. The heads appear granular or fuzzy, and the stalks are pale and slightly translucent. Structures are loosely clustered, emerging from a blue-green, velvety substrate.

Small, whitish, blister-like pustules form discrete, slightly granular, and somewhat translucent raised spots along the leaf veins. The pustules are not uniformly fuzzy and are localized to specific areas, contrasting with the healthy surrounding leaf tissue.

Two mature fruiting bodies with dark brown to blackish, uneven caps and robust, cylindrical stipes. Gills are crowded and heavily stained dark brown to black. The stipe texture is rough and fibrous, with pale flesh visible in the split specimen.

Numerous small, white, slightly raised pustules cluster along the central vein of the green leaf. The pustules are rounded, powdery to granular in texture, and stand out against the healthy green tissue, with some subtle discoloration around them.

Numerous small, scattered yellow-orange pustules cover the underside of the lobed green leaf, forming slightly raised spots along veins and interveinal areas, with some merging into larger patches. Infected areas appear roughened compared to the surrounding tissue.

Dense, mat-like aggregation of dark, gelatinous, convoluted thallus with a wrinkled, lobed surface. Numerous small, rounded, blackish apothecia scattered throughout, creating a bumpy, granular texture. Surface appears moist, slightly shiny, with embedded mineral particles and occasional greenish or yellowish patches.

Dense cluster of light brown to tan mushrooms with convex to flat caps, some showing a central depression and faintly fibrous texture. Margins are mostly even, with a few undulating. Crowded gills and slender, similarly colored stipes are visible on an upturned specimen.

Several small, dark, mound-like structures with a dense, fuzzy or hairy surface. Fine, hair-like projections cover the uneven, nearly black surface, giving a woolly, tufted appearance with scattered particulate debris.

Small, irregularly shaped grayish to brownish fruiting bodies with a matte, powdery surface. Some appear lobed or contorted, scattered among green moss. Margins are smooth and no distinct stalks are visible.

Several minute, smooth, shiny, brownish to reddish globose fruiting bodies are slightly raised and loosely clustered on a dark, moist patch of substrate. Each rounded structure is entire, with a subtle sheen and a scattered arrangement among wood fibers.

Large, broadly convex to flat cap with a depressed center, grayish-black and moist surface, shiny texture, and numerous irregular pits and holes. The margin is irregular and slightly curled, with signs of damage and age.

Broad caps with dark gray to brown mottled surfaces, slightly depressed centers, and faintly striate margins. Gills are closely spaced, white to cream. Stipe is robust, white, and slightly soiled, with some brownish discoloration. Leaf debris adheres to the cap.

Broad, convex to flattened caps with grayish-brown, patchy surfaces and wavy margins. Gills are closely spaced, pale to grayish, and attached to thick, solid stipes. Some caps show surface debris and age-related damage.

A single green leaf with a wavy, undulating surface and numerous sharp, spine-like outgrowths along the margins and midrib. The leaf appears healthy and intact, with a prominent central vein and glossy texture.

Dense clusters of minute, upright, hair-like filaments form a fuzzy, bristly mat. The structures are predominantly dark brown to black, creating irregular patches with a delicate, intricate texture across the surface.

Small, greenish, granular, and globose structures with rough, uneven surfaces and irregular margins. Some display tufts of white, powdery mycelium, giving a mottled appearance. Colonies are scattered and separated, with a translucent invertebrate nearby.

Crust-like, effused growth with a whitish to pale gray, powdery surface. Texture is finely granular and velvety, with irregular, slightly raised patches and scattered small pores. Uneven surface reveals darker underlying areas, and the margin blends diffusely into the background.

Dense, irregularly convoluted surface with off-white to cream coloration. Texture appears cottony to spongy, featuring numerous small, rounded, clustered protuberances forming a thick mat. Margin is indistinct, merging with the substrate, with some fluffy patches at the edges.

Numerous small, rounded to irregular fruitbodies with pale cream to light brown tones, some whitish, featuring prominent dark dot-like speckles. The surface appears powdery to granular, with irregular, merging margins and a patchy, scattered distribution on the wood.

Numerous small, black, nearly spherical to irregularly rounded fruiting bodies with a distinctly fuzzy or setose surface, scattered across a pale, featureless background. The fruiting bodies have a granular or hairy appearance and are irregularly arranged, with some appearing slightly clustered.

Extensive, thin, crust-like patches tightly adhering to bark, off-white to pale grayish in color, with a granular to powdery surface texture and irregular, diffuse margins. The growth is flat, continuous, and patchy, following the contours and crevices of the wood.

Minute, pale to yellowish-tan, disc-like fruitbodies scattered and closely appressed to the surface. The fruitbodies are smooth, moist, and translucent, with indistinct margins due to their tiny size, each only a fraction of a millimeter across.

Dense, powdery to velvety bluish-green mat with numerous upright, white to off-white tufts and granular, uneven surface. Irregular patches and diffuse margins blend into the substrate, with prolific sporulating mold appearance.

Extensive, resupinate patch with pale cream to off-white color, featuring an irregular, warty surface covered in small, rounded to angular tuberculate bumps. The diffuse margin blends into the substrate, bordered in places by green moss or algae.

Small, dark brown thallus with radiating, distinctly lobed arms. Surface is glossy, lumpy, and wrinkled, especially at the center. Margins are flattened with undulate, crenate edges. Soil particles adhere to the gelatinous texture.
Elongated, curved white structure with a rough, irregular, and porous surface, partially covered in soil. Lacks visible cap, gills, or volva, and displays cavities and eroded areas along its length.
Numerous small, irregularly rounded, yellowish to ochre fruiting bodies with a granular, uneven surface are closely clustered in a discontinuous line along a dark substrate.

Dense, woolly white mat with irregular, coral-like tufts and a cottony, matted texture. Subtle pinkish tones appear at the uneven margins. The surface is closely appressed to the wood, forming a spreading, felt-like patch.

Numerous small, black, granular to coarsely warted patches form a low, crustose layer among moss tufts. The surface appears matte to slightly glossy, rough, and uneven, with no visible stalks or distinct fruiting bodies.

Numerous small, white, circular to oval pustules are scattered across the green leaf surface. The pustules are slightly raised, giving a blistered or bubbled appearance, with some forming small clusters and others appearing isolated.

Dense, fine-grained, dark brown to nearly black mat with irregular, granular, and slightly rough surface. Small, clustered lobes form a crustose to squamulose texture, closely appressed to the moss substrate.

Small, white, slightly raised pustules scattered across the green leaf surface. The pustules are rounded, discrete, and have a faintly granular or powdery texture, standing out against the smooth leaf background.

Dark brown to blackish, crust-like patches tightly adhere to the surface, featuring a granular to tuberculate texture with small, rounded or irregular warts arranged in loose vertical aggregations. The surface appears uneven and encrusting, lacking distinct margins or visible reproductive structures.

Broad, reddish-brown caps with wavy, irregular edges and dry surfaces. Gills are closely spaced and pale brown. Stems are thick, pale to whitish with yellowish stains and soil debris at the base. Caps and stems appear robust and fleshy.

Numerous tiny, cup-shaped structures with cream-colored centers and distinctly darker, brown, fringed margins densely covered in prominent hair-like cilia. The fruitbodies are scattered and sometimes clustered, with finely textured surfaces.

Dense clusters of small, disc-shaped fruiting bodies with dull to medium brown, minutely granular surfaces. The apothecia are closely packed, forming a contiguous mat, with entire, slightly flattened margins and a rough texture from adhering sand and debris.

A small, dense tuft of greyish, hair-like filaments radiates outward in a fluffy, cottony cluster. The fine, delicate threads create a soft, airy appearance, standing out against a darker, blurred background.
Thin, crust-like layer tightly attached to the surface, pale off-white to cream in color, with a finely granular, powdery texture and diffuse, irregular margins blending into the background.

Dense clusters of small, dark, circular discs scattered across a rough, granular, nearly black surface. The discs are slightly raised with a matte finish, contrasting against the coarse, uneven, lumpy background.

Numerous small, dark, nearly spherical to slightly irregular fruiting bodies with a fuzzy, granular surface are scattered in loose clusters across a pale background. Margins are indistinct and sizes vary slightly.

Broad, depressed cap with dark gray to blackish tones and a slightly uneven margin. Smooth surface with minor debris. Gills are closely spaced, white to cream, and the robust stipe is pale brown to grayish, cylindrical, and unornamented.

White to cream, closely spaced gills radiate from a pale cap margin. The cap shows some brownish discoloration and a smooth texture. A yellow pencil provides scale, highlighting the medium size of the fruiting body.

Minute, nearly black, globose to subglobose fruiting bodies with a granular surface, scattered and partially embedded among fibrous organic debris. No visible stalks or distinct margins; fruiting bodies appear directly on the substrate.

A dense cluster of small, spherical to oval bodies with a white to pale gray, powdery surface. The structures are closely packed, some with disrupted surfaces, and lack visible stalks, appearing directly attached to a dark substrate.

Irregular, spreading patch with a dense white center and fluffy, cottony texture. Margins display prominent, radiating tufts in pinkish to pale lilac hues, giving a soft, fibrous appearance closely attached to the wood.

Small, dark, globose to slightly elongated fruiting bodies densely clustered, each covered in fine, hair-like setae for a fuzzy, matte, velvety appearance. Margins blend into the substrate, with no sharply defined edges.

Dense cluster of mushrooms with light to medium brown, dry, finely textured caps, some cracked or split. Caps range from convex to slightly depressed with wavy margins. Long, slender, fibrous stems and closely spaced, decurrent light brown gills.

Dense clusters of small, dark brown to black, button-like discs with a granular, bumpy surface. The rounded structures are embedded in a compact, irregular, and slightly gelatinous mass, giving a leathery and uneven appearance.

Dense cluster of small, golden-brown, spherical bodies with glossy surfaces, each showing smooth margins and some with tiny openings at the apex, forming a compact, cushion-like mass on a dark surface.

A tiny, round to slightly domed fruitbody with a smooth, brownish, somewhat translucent surface and subtle sheen. A small, white, cylindrical structure is attached at the base. The fungus appears solitary against a textured, woody background.

Clusters of upright, slender, pale stalks topped with small, globose, white, powdery heads. The heads have a dense, fuzzy or cottony texture, and the arrangement is scattered among bluish-green, powdery mycelium.

Convex, yellowish-ochre cap with brown mottling and a slightly inrolled, uneven margin. Pale, closely spaced gills beneath. Thick, white stem with yellow stains and fibrous texture, slightly bulbous at the base, with soil debris attached.

Extensive blue to grayish-blue crust covering wood, with a powdery to velvety texture. The surface is uneven, showing granular and cracked areas, and the diffuse, irregular margin blends into the substrate.

Clustered, cushion-shaped yellow to pale ochre bodies with a glossy, moist appearance and distinctly bumpy, minutely pitted surfaces. Rounded, lobed margins and tightly grouped growth emerging from the substrate.
Small, yellow, globose to irregularly rounded structures with a moist, slightly glistening surface, scattered and clustered on a dark background, surrounded by a whitish, cottony mat.

A patchy, resupinate crust with whitish to pale brown, felted and cottony texture, spreading irregularly across the wood. The surface is fibrous, with diffuse margins blending into the substrate and scattered small, white, cottony tufts.

Minute, dark brown to nearly black thalli with a distinctly wrinkled, convoluted, and brain-like surface. The clustered, irregularly lobed structures have a rough, uneven texture and lack visible reproductive bodies. Scale bar indicates very small size.

Thin, crust-like layer tightly adhering to wood, off-white to grayish in color with a powdery, pruinose surface. Irregular patches follow the wood’s contours, appearing smooth to slightly granular without distinct fruiting bodies or margins.

Highly magnified pale yellowish surface with a glossy sheen, scattered with numerous minute, dark, hair-like setae emerging from small, slightly sunken points. The texture is smooth to slightly uneven, with setae as a prominent feature.

Numerous small, bright orange, oval to elongated pustules are scattered and loosely grouped along the veins of the green leaf. Some pustules coalesce, forming irregular patches with necrotic tissue. The pustules are slightly raised, powdery, and distinctly outlined against the leaf surface.

Numerous tiny, dark brown to nearly black, cup-shaped fruiting bodies densely scattered across a greenish-brown stem. The apothecia are sessile, with slightly raised margins and smooth to subtly textured surfaces, forming tight clusters.

Leaves display numerous small, irregular, brownish to dark reddish spots scattered across the surface, with some curling and margin damage. Lesions are slightly raised, disrupting the normal green coloration, and some areas show necrosis or yellowing.

Solitary mushroom with a smooth, pale tan to light brown, broadly convex cap and even margin. The cap surface is dry and unadorned. The long, slender stipe is white and emerges directly from the soil.

Small, dark, rounded structures densely covered with fine, pale gray, hair-like setae, giving a distinctly fuzzy appearance. The surface is rough and irregular, with compact, somewhat clustered forms among decomposing material.

Numerous tiny, pale yellow to ochre, disc-shaped fruiting bodies with smooth, slightly translucent surfaces. Some display dark, granular centers. The discs are scattered and partially embedded among fibrous plant debris, with even, non-raised margins.

Clustered mushrooms with dark brown, dry, scaly caps featuring large, irregular pale patches. Gills are white to cream, free, and closely spaced. Stems are slender, fibrous, and mottled brown with pale areas, some showing soil remnants at the base.

Cluster of mushrooms with convex to slightly flattened ochre-brown caps, some showing surface cracks. Stems are thick, pale with yellowish tinges, and bases covered in soil. One specimen is cut to reveal a thick, pale yellow interior.

Delicate, translucent white sporangia with a papery, crumpled texture form irregular, torn-looking sheets. The tiny structures are loosely clustered, with fine yellowish threads at their base, giving a fragile and ephemeral appearance.
Dense tufts of fine, grayish, hair-like filaments form soft, fuzzy clusters on a dark substrate, with several upright, yellowish stalks scattered among the mycelial growth.

Thick, resupinate crust tightly attached to wood, with a dense, warty, and tuberculate surface. The coloration varies from creamy white to pale tan with pinkish and brownish patches. The margin is diffuse, and the texture is granular and uneven, forming convoluted ridges and folds.

Robust mushroom with a thick, cylindrical brown stem and a granular, mottled apex. The broad cap margin is undulating and darkened. Crowded, pale gills darken near the edge, and the surface appears smooth to slightly granular.

Broad, flat to slightly concave cap with dark grayish-black coloration, uneven moist surface, and several irregular holes. Smooth, slightly wavy margin. Robust, dark cylindrical stipe. Pale, closely spaced gills visible beneath the cap.

Two robust, club-shaped fruit bodies cut lengthwise, displaying a dark, nearly blackish-brown, fibrous exterior and a sharply contrasting pale, marbled interior. The sectioned surfaces reveal firm, dense flesh with a clear distinction between cap and stipe.

Numerous fine, hair-like, dark filaments emerge in tufts from the decayed surface, forming slender, upright, bristly clusters with a delicate, fuzzy texture. The coloration is predominantly dark brown to black, and the growth appears scattered and irregular across the substrate.

Small, dark brown to black thalli with a convoluted, wrinkled, and lobed surface. The texture appears gelatinous or leathery, and the thalli are compact, irregularly grouped, and closely appressed to the substrate.

Dense aggregation of minute, dark, rounded structures forming a nearly black, crustose surface. Numerous small, round, disc-like fruiting bodies are scattered throughout, slightly raised and dark brown to black. The texture is granular to warty, with compact, closely attached growth.

Dense, irregular patches of blackish to deep brown, granular crust cover the surface, with numerous small, rounded, dark discs slightly raised above the compact, rough texture. Fine mineral particles are scattered throughout the granular thallus.
Compact, irregularly rounded body with yellowish-green color. Surface is moist, shiny, and covered in small, raised, rounded bumps, giving a granular appearance. Margins are lobed and uneven.

A small, dark, rounded mound densely covered with fine, radiating hair-like projections, creating a spiky, brush-like appearance. The surface is textured and fuzzy, with prominent setae extending outward from the central body.

Tiny, white, rounded to irregular fruiting bodies with a chalky, crustose surface. Some are slightly flattened or lobed, with a few showing dark, ruptured areas. Margins are mostly smooth but appear uneven due to the granular texture. Closely grouped and less than 1 mm in diameter.

Two mushrooms with broad, flat to slightly depressed caps, mottled grayish-brown and covered in soil and leaf debris. One cap margin is irregular and wavy. Exposed gills are closely spaced, pale cream, and brittle. Stipe is mostly obscured by debris.

A dense, cushion-like mass composed of tightly packed, small, globose to subglobose structures. The surface is finely granular and slightly rough, with a uniform yellowish-olive to brown coloration. Margins are irregular and individual rounded bodies are closely appressed.

A single mushroom with a long, smooth, white stem and densely packed, white gills visible from below. The cap is not visible in this view. The stipe appears robust and unblemished, with faint discoloration.

Pale cream to off-white patch with densely packed, irregular, brain-like folds and tuberculate protrusions. The margin is distinctly white, fuzzy, and tomentose, contrasting with the moist, convoluted central surface tightly attached to the wood.

Minute, clustered, cup-like fruiting bodies with a distinctly fuzzy, filamentous surface. Light to medium brown coloration, irregularly grouped, and sessile. The texture is rough and bristly, giving a setose appearance under magnification.

Several small, oval leaves display a muted pink to reddish discoloration among healthy green foliage. The affected leaves appear slightly thickened and stand out against the surrounding vibrant green leaves and thin brown stems.
Tiny, shallow, cup-shaped fruitbodies with a dull orange-brown color and finely textured surface, sparsely scattered and nestled in the crevices of decaying wood.

Pear fruit with extensive dark, rough, and cracked lesions. The skin shows brown to black discoloration, sunken and desiccated areas, bumpy texture, and irregular fissures, with yellowish-green mottling around the affected regions.
Tiny, round to oval orange-brown fruiting bodies with smooth, moist surfaces are scattered in small clusters on a patch of white, cottony mycelium covering woody substrate.

Two small mushrooms with smooth, convex, pale tan to light brown caps and thin, fragile-looking pale stems. The cap margins are even and the surface appears dry, lacking scales or warts. Gills are not visible.

Minute, dome-shaped, light brown apothecia with slightly darker centers scattered across a granular green surface. The apothecia are finely textured and matte, surrounded by a network of delicate, hair-like threads. Scale bar indicates very small size.

Numerous minute, brown, powdery pustules densely scattered along the veins and jagged edges of narrow green leaves, forming a speckled pattern. The pustules appear slightly raised and concentrated on the leaf undersides.

Slender, pale whitish stem with some soil at the base, supporting a medium brown, convex cap. The cap surface is matte to slightly velvety with fine radial striations and an even margin. No gills are visible from this angle.

A tiny, solitary mushroom with a smooth, light brown convex cap and a thin, short stipe. The fruiting body is minute, standing alone on a piece of brown plant debris against a neutral gray background.

Numerous small, dark, oval to irregularly shaped spots scattered across a light brown, striated stem. The spots are slightly raised with a matte, subtly textured surface, distributed both singly and in loose clusters.

Clustered mushrooms with convex to slightly flattened light to medium brown caps, some showing subtle mottling and faintly scalloped edges. Stems are slender, elongated, pale brown to whitish, and fibrous. Gills are moderately spaced and brown, matching the cap color.

Broad, pale cream to tan caps with irregular, torn margins and dry, slightly fibrous surfaces. Crowded brownish gills are visible on one specimen. White, cylindrical stems show brownish stains and soil remnants. Medium-sized fruiting bodies scattered among leaf litter.

Continuous greenish crust with a granular to areolate texture, forming small, irregular patches separated by cracks. The surface is uneven, rough, and tightly appressed, with a somewhat powdery appearance and no visible reproductive structures.

Thick, light purple stem with a paler upper zone, encircled by rusty-orange veil remnants. Cap margin is wavy and pinkish-lilac. Densely packed, light brown gills beneath a smooth, moist surface. Some soil and debris cling to the stem.

Circular, light brown cap with a finely textured, velvety surface and subtle radial striations. The margin is even, and a pale, smooth stipe is partially visible. The cap appears small to medium-sized with no visible gills.

Robust mushroom with a smooth, moist, light purple to lilac cap and thick stem. The stem shows a gradient from deep purple near the cap to a paler base, with a bulbous zone and soil adhering. Pale, closely spaced gills are visible beneath the cap.

Viewed from below, this mushroom displays densely packed, dark brown gills radiating from the center. The long, curved stipe is coated with soil and debris, with a partial veil remnant near the top. The cap surface is not visible.

Mushroom with a convex, light brown cap featuring darker patches and a slightly uneven edge. The smooth, sturdy white stem shows brownish discoloration near the base. White, closely spaced gills are visible beneath the cap.
Several small, round, brownish-orange fruiting bodies with a slightly granular or velvety surface are closely grouped and sessile. Fine, whitish mycelial threads spread across the dark background.
A tiny, convex, pale to light brown cap with a smooth surface sits atop a slender, off-white stem, both appearing minute against a narrow strip of brown plant material.
No visible fungal structures are present; only a shiny, dark beetle with brown markings and ridged elytra is seen.
Rounded, dark, globose structures with smooth to slightly cracked surfaces, partially enveloped by reddish-brown, papery bracts. The clusters are tightly integrated with the surrounding plant tissue.
Centrally positioned white stem with a prominent, membranous ring. Densely packed, free gills are pinkish and the cap margin is smooth and pale. Soil and leaf debris cling to the base.

Vivid green, cracked and areolate crust tightly appressed, with a rough, granular surface. Scattered small, black, rounded spots dot the thallus, and the margins blend indistinctly into the background.

A tiny, reddish-brown, convex cap with a striate margin sits atop an extremely slender, elongated, thread-like brown stipe. The cap appears smooth, delicate, and semi-translucent, emphasizing the fragile, minute fruiting body.

Light brown, conical to bell-shaped caps with slightly grooved, translucent margins. Dark brown, densely packed gills beneath. Slender, white to pale brown fibrous stems, some with soil at the base. Smooth cap surface and delicate, straight stipes.

Scattered, small, dark, irregularly shaped patches embedded in a reddish and whitish bark surface. The fungal areas appear crustose and patchy, with a slightly raised texture and no distinct grouping or elongated forms.
Two slender mushrooms with elongated white stems and smooth, convex light brown caps. The gills are pale and radiate distinctly from the stem, with a delicate, almost translucent appearance.

Numerous small, densely clustered, roughly spherical fruiting bodies with a granular, slightly roughened surface. The color ranges from brown to ochre, and some fine, hair-like structures are visible among the tightly packed spheres.

Large, thick-stemmed mushroom with a yellowish stem streaked red and intense blue bruising. Cap is pinkish to reddish, velvety, with blue-green stains and irregular margin. Cut flesh and yellow pores show strong blue staining where damaged.

Sectioned fruiting bodies with smooth, pale caps and slightly incurved margins. Gills are densely packed, thin, and distinctly pink. White, fibrous stipes are centrally attached, with remnants of a partial veil near the cap margin.

Broad, semicircular shelf-like fruiting body with a pale off-white to tan surface, marked by darker concentric zones and a rough, ridged texture. The margin is rounded and thickened, and the fungus is attached laterally to the tree trunk.
Several small, black, rounded to slightly irregular fruiting bodies with smooth, somewhat shiny surfaces are partially embedded and scattered across a pale, woody background.

Small mushroom with a conical to convex, medium to dark brown cap showing a dry, finely fibrillose surface. Gills are closely spaced, brownish, and attached to a slender, ochre-tan fibrous stem with soil clinging to the base.

Dense cluster of grayish-green, flat, leaf-like lobes with undulate, irregular margins. Surface appears smooth to slightly wrinkled, with overlapping thalli forming a contiguous mat. Some darker spots are visible, and the texture looks leathery and tightly appressed.

Dense clusters of grayish-white, broad, rounded lobes with undulate, irregularly crenate margins. The surface is smooth to slightly granular, with darker mottling and scattered blackish patches. Thalli are closely appressed, forming a contiguous mat.

A resupinate, crust-like growth tightly adheres to wood, displaying a pale yellow to cream surface with densely packed, irregular, maze-like pores. The margin is even and gradually blends into the substrate, and the texture appears dry and fibrous.

Small, rounded, dark fruiting bodies scattered irregularly across a pale, smooth, striated woody surface. The fruiting bodies are slightly raised with a nipple-like appearance, sharply contrasting with the lighter background.

Numerous tiny, white, smooth, globose to slightly oval bodies scattered and well separated on a rough, dark brown surface. No visible stalks; fruiting bodies appear directly attached to the substrate.

Dense cluster of pale greenish-gray to brown lobes with rough, granular surfaces and undulate, irregular margins. Some upright, irregularly branched structures are present, interspersed with small twigs or debris.

Dense, white, powdery or web-like growth spreads irregularly across the green surface, forming a patchy, reticulate network. The fine, filamentous texture appears more concentrated in some areas and more diffuse in others, with no visible fruiting bodies.

Pale gray to greenish, cracked and areolate surface with numerous black, rounded, slightly sunken discs scattered across rough, granular patches. The discs have distinct margins and are embedded in the crustose thallus.

Dense, irregular patches with a granular, grayish-black surface. The thallus appears crustose and compact, with tightly clustered granules creating a rough, nodular texture. Margins are diffuse and blend into the surrounding area.

Tiny, translucent to light brown or pinkish disc-shaped bodies scattered across a rough, cracked surface. The fruiting bodies are smooth, moist-looking, and slightly gelatinous, with even margins and subtle size variation.

Greenish surface with numerous scattered, rounded dark spots and a smooth texture. A small pale fragment is present, while the main area shows slightly raised blackish dots across the green thallus. The margin is not visible in this close-up view.

Thin, whitish to pale crust-like layer with a powdery to granular texture, closely adhering to the surface. The margin is diffuse and irregular, blending seamlessly into the substrate with no visible cap or distinct structures.

Creamy white to pale tan, crust-like surface with irregular, elongated, interconnected pores forming a maze-like, reticulate pattern. Texture appears spongy and uneven, with a rough, undulating surface and no clearly defined margin.
A dense, powdery, white to pale green coating forms a fine, fuzzy, velvety layer on the green leaf surface, with slightly thicker granular patches and diffuse coverage extending to the leaf margin.
Creamy white, closely spaced gills run down a laterally attached, fibrous and wrinkled stem. The cap surface is not visible. The fruiting body is large, with a gloved hand nearby for scale.

Numerous small, white, disc-shaped structures with a granular or powdery surface are scattered closely together. Each disc has a slightly raised margin and a flat to shallowly concave center, standing out against a yellow-green and dark background.
Numerous tiny, orange to reddish-orange, disc-shaped fruiting bodies with smooth, gelatinous surfaces and even margins, scattered in patchy clusters across a pale background.

Numerous tiny, round, whitish to pale cream discs densely clustered, each with a finely granular or slightly fuzzy surface and even margins. The minute fruiting bodies are closely packed and lack visible stalks.
Irregular, crust-like tan to ochre patches with rough, scaly, uneven texture. The margins are diffuse and blend into the bark, forming scattered, resupinate growths along the woody surface.

Irregular, crustose patches with a granular, powdery surface. Predominantly dark gray to nearly black, interspersed with rusty orange-brown areas. The thallus is compact, uneven, and lacks distinct margins, with tightly clustered granules and no visible reproductive structures.

Tall, slender mushrooms with pale stems and smooth, light brown conical to convex caps. The caps have striate, translucent margins and moist surfaces. Pale, closely spaced gills are visible beneath the caps. One smaller, rounded immature specimen is present.

Crustose, granular surface with lumpy, uneven texture. Coloration varies from grayish to greenish and brownish, densely covered in small, wart-like granules. Margins are diffuse, blending into the substrate, with a mottled, patchy appearance.

Dense cluster of small, irregular, green to pale green thallus segments with granular, slightly rough surfaces. Margins are lobed and undulate, some areas show brownish or tan discoloration. Segments overlap, forming a compact, mat-like aggregation.

Pale whitish to light green, irregularly lobed and contorted structures form a loosely aggregated, mound-like mass. Margins are uneven and upturned, with a brittle, crisp texture and scattered dark debris on the surface.

Numerous small, globose to subglobose, translucent to whitish gelatinous bodies form dense, irregular clusters. The surface appears moist, glistening, and somewhat slimy, with tightly packed fruiting bodies of varying size embedded on a dark, rough background.

Broad, overlapping lobes with pale gray to bluish-gray coloration, slightly wrinkled and undulate surface, and rounded, crenate margins. Some areas show greenish or brownish tints. The texture appears leathery, forming a dense, contiguous mat.

Broadly convex to nearly flat caps, pale greenish to yellowish, smooth with leaf debris. Even, non-striate margins. Underside shows closely spaced white gills and a smooth, cylindrical, white to faintly pinkish stipe.

Dense cluster of irregular, lobed segments with a granular to powdery surface. Colors range from pale brown to grayish-brown, with whitish or pale greenish patches. Margins are uneven and slightly upturned, forming a compact, three-dimensional mass.

Broad, flat patch with overlapping, irregularly lobed margins. Surface is light green to grayish, slightly powdery, and tightly appressed. Lobes are rounded with subtle undulations and some darkened or upturned edges, forming a leafy, textured appearance.

Thin, crust-like layer tightly adhering to the surface, predominantly whitish to pale gray with darker patches along cracks. The texture appears finely granular or powdery, with diffuse, irregular margins blending into the substrate.

Dense clusters of small, white to pale bluish, moist, translucent spheres tightly packed in an irregular, granular layer on a dark surface. The spheres vary slightly in size and create a pronounced color contrast with the background.
Small, closely grouped, disc-shaped fruiting bodies with a light orange to peach hue and smooth, slightly translucent surfaces. Margins are even and not prominently raised.

A small, hemispherical to shallowly cup-shaped fruiting body with a smooth, moist, glossy orange surface. The margin is paler, slightly raised, and appears gelatinous or translucent, with fine granulation visible across the surface.

Three mushrooms with convex to bell-shaped, dry, fibrous light brown caps. Densely packed dark brown gills are visible on one upturned specimen. Stems are slender, cylindrical, brownish with lighter patches, and soil clings to the bases. No rings or veil remnants present.

A solitary mushroom with a centrally depressed, pinkish-red cap fading to white at the margin, smooth and slightly waxy in texture. The white, stout stem is smooth, and the cap surface has a subtle sheen.
Pale gray to whitish, crust-like surface with a cracked, rough texture. Numerous small, black, rounded spots are scattered across, some with slightly raised edges, giving a speckled appearance.

Dense cluster of pale yellow to golden, fan-shaped caps with smooth surfaces and wavy, frilled margins. Overlapping fruiting bodies show decurrent gills beneath, and the texture appears soft and delicate. Caps often fuse together, forming a layered, shelf-like arrangement.
Slender, white stems support smooth, convex caps that are light brown with slightly darker centers. Gills underneath are pale. Mushrooms are clustered and scattered among dense green grass.

Dense patches of pale gray, broad, irregularly lobed thalli with slightly granular surfaces. Lobes have rounded margins and are edged with fine blackish cilia, overlapping closely and forming a continuous mat.

Two small, vivid orange, cup-shaped fruiting bodies with smooth, moist surfaces and even, slightly raised rims. The cups are circular and bowl-like, standing out sharply against the surrounding green moss.

A granular, patchy mat of small, irregular, grayish-green to pale green granules forms a rough, powdery crust. The surface is uneven, with diffuse margins blending into the surroundings. No distinct cup-like or lobed structures are visible.

Slender mushrooms with conical to bell-shaped, smooth ochre-brown caps featuring striate margins. Stipes are thin, fragile, ochre to yellowish-brown with whitish fibrillose remnants near the base. Gills are pale, closely spaced, and visible on the horizontally positioned specimen.

Numerous small, white, rounded to slightly oval structures with a distinctly granular to minutely hairy, fuzzy surface. The fruitbodies are closely grouped, uniform in size, and have even margins, standing out against a dark background.

Crustose, leprose thallus with a mottled, granular surface. Colors range from gray, brown, and white to greenish tints, with distinctive orange patches and scattered small, rounded brownish structures. The texture is rough and uneven, forming an irregular mosaic.

Small, bright orange, cup-shaped fruitbodies with smooth, vivid inner surfaces and distinct white rims, scattered and sessile among dense green moss. The cups have well-defined, pale margins and a smooth, waxy texture.

A field of rounded, translucent structures densely packed, each displaying intricate, radiating, reticulate surface patterns. The internal ornamentation appears as dark, branching lines within each circular element. No larger structures are visible.

Tiny, upright fruiting bodies with slender, dark stalks topped by small, rounded to slightly flattened yellowish, powdery heads. The heads have a finely granular texture and are spaced apart on the surface.

Granular, crustose thallus with a lumpy, uneven surface. Predominantly dark brown to black, interspersed with powdery greenish-yellow patches. Surface appears rough, irregular, and compact, with scattered particulate matter and no visible reproductive structures.
A tiny, solitary, cup-shaped fruiting body with a vivid orange, smooth inner surface and a slightly paler, minutely scalloped margin. The fungus is nestled among green moss and fine soil grains.

Dense, mat-like mound of small, overlapping olive-green to brownish squamules with a granular, minutely foliose texture. Squamule margins are irregular and slightly lobed, forming a compact, tightly packed surface with occasional moss and soil particles interspersed.
A patch of soil with scattered low green and brown vegetation and mosses. No distinct fungal structures or visible fruiting bodies are apparent at this scale.

A tightly adhering, crust-like layer with a light brown to yellowish hue, featuring a dense honeycomb pattern of small, angular pores. The surface appears spongy and porous, with a thin, paler margin blending into the substrate.

Medium-sized mushrooms with smooth, matte, broadly convex to nearly flat brown caps, some showing darker centers. Gills are crowded, pale brown to tan, and free to slightly attached. Cylindrical, pale brown stipes lack rings or volvas. Texture appears dry, with some soil at the stipe bases.

Numerous tiny, round, bright orange discs with smooth, flat to slightly concave surfaces and well-defined margins, clustered and scattered among dense green moss and organic debris. The fruiting bodies are sessile and stand out vividly against the surrounding vegetation.

Gelatinous, irregularly lobed mass with dark brown to nearly black coloration. Surface appears moist, shiny, and somewhat translucent with uneven, undulating margins. The fungus forms a single, spreading patch attached directly to a small branch.

Dense mat of overlapping, broad, irregularly lobed thalli with pale bluish-gray upper surfaces, darker mottling, and granular speckling. Lobes are rounded, slightly undulate, and closely appressed, forming contiguous patches with a smooth to slightly wrinkled texture.

Hemispherical to convex cap with a pale yellowish-brown, smooth, moist surface and a slightly darker center. Slender, elongated, pale cream to tan stipe with a fibrous texture and distinctly bulbous base. Approximately 5.5 cm tall.

Minute, tubular to cup-shaped fruiting bodies with pale yellowish to tan coloration, smooth to slightly granular surface, and even margins. Scattered arrangement on a dark substrate with patches of green material. Fruiting bodies are small and closely attached to the substrate.
A fine, powdery white coating covers the leaf surface, dotted with numerous small, rounded fruiting bodies in yellow to reddish-brown hues, irregularly scattered and embedded within the mycelial mat.

A dense cluster of long, slender, dark brown to black thread-like filaments rising vertically, forming a bushy, hair-like mass. The glossy filaments are covered in small moisture droplets, giving a delicate, glistening appearance. Individual filaments emerge tightly packed from a central base.

A continuous, crust-like mat with a densely packed surface of short, cylindrical to conical projections. The texture is granular and uneven, and the coloration is a uniform light tan to ochre. No distinct margin is visible in this close-up view.

Elongated, coiled, rope-like brown structure firmly attached along the leaf surface. The segmented mass is slightly raised with a rough, granular texture, contrasting sharply against the smooth, green leaf.

Slender, thread-like stalks rise vertically, each topped with a small, smooth, yellowish spherical head. The arrangement is sparse, with each delicate filament bearing a single globose structure at its tip.

Irregular, crust-like structure with a dark, nearly black surface bordered by a yellowish margin. Patches of white material are present, and the texture appears granular and uneven, with a brittle, papery consistency.
Small, rounded, yellowish-orange fruiting bodies with a granular surface cluster tightly together on a rough brown substrate. The apothecia are minute, sessile, and have smooth, well-defined margins.

Numerous small, bright orange, disc-shaped fruiting bodies with smooth, slightly glossy surfaces and well-defined margins are clustered on sandy ground among charred wood and twigs. The apothecia are circular to oval, less than a centimeter wide, and stand out vividly against the muted background.

Mushroom with a smooth, slightly translucent cap margin and closely spaced, pale beige gills. The stem is long, slender, and pale brown with darker patches. The cap appears moist and the gills are moderately broad.

Dense clusters of upright, slender, translucent stalks topped with small, spherical yellowish to brownish heads. The thread-like structures create a delicate, brush-like appearance above the dark, organic substrate.

Medium to light brown, conical to bell-shaped caps with wavy, uplifted margins. Long, slender, pale to yellowish-buff stems with fibrous texture and soil debris. Closely spaced, pale brown gills visible on upturned fruiting bodies.

Convex brown caps with smooth to slightly fibrillose surfaces, densely packed brownish to purplish gills, and robust pale stems with brown and purplish tinges. Sectioned specimens reveal a pale to purplish interior and remnants of soil at the base.

A cluster of pale tan, elongated, and contorted branches radiates outward from a central mass. The surface is rough and irregular, with the branches appearing uneven and twisted. The fungus is attached to a dark object, accentuating its intricate, branched form.

Two mushrooms with pale beige to light brown caps, one convex and one slightly depressed. The gills are cream to pale yellow, closely spaced, and adnate. The stems are cylindrical, with soil adhering to one. Cap margins are mostly entire, with one showing a missing section.

A thin, extensive crust-like patch with a granular to minutely warted surface, light brown to ochre in color, blending into the wood. The margin is diffuse and irregular, merging gradually with the substrate.

Dense cluster of long, slender, upright dark filaments topped with tiny, smooth, spherical heads. Numerous water droplets cling to the wiry structures, creating a glistening effect. The overall texture is delicate and filamentous, with green moss visible at the base.

Pale, elongated body with a rough, fibrous surface, bearing numerous irregular, finger-like beige projections radiating outward. The projections vary in length and thickness, creating a tangled, contorted appearance. The main structure is attached to a thin, dark support.

Elongated woody stems coated with a thin, patchy layer of grayish-white mycelium. The surface appears diffuse, powdery to velvety, with irregular, uneven coverage and no visible fruiting bodies or distinct margins.

Irregular blackish patches embedded in a rough, granular matrix of translucent, amber-brown, and pale cream fragments. The surface appears mottled, with flaky, crystalline textures and scattered dark granules.

Small, cup-shaped fruiting bodies with a smooth, matte surface. The largest is dark brown with a finely fringed, lighter margin, while several smaller ones below are bright yellow-orange, smooth, and slightly translucent.

Granular, patchy surface with scattered reddish-brown to ochre spots on a grayish, uneven, and powdery background. The structures are irregularly grouped, lacking clear margins or distinct fruiting bodies at this magnification.

Extensive, thin crust with a grayish, granular to warty surface. Lower area shows a white, porous or reticulate pattern. Margin is irregular and merges seamlessly with the substrate. No distinct fruiting bodies or caps are visible.

Clusters of thin, leaf-like lobes with frilled, undulating margins. Surfaces show a mix of greenish and brown hues, with an irregular, somewhat lacy texture. Brownish debris is scattered among the compact, contiguous patches.

Pale cream to tan, slender, wiry projections radiate outward from a central mass, forming elongated, curved structures with a smooth to slightly fibrous surface. All projections emerge from a single point, creating a spiky, starburst-like appearance.

A central, flattened, pale beige mass with numerous elongated, cream-colored, finger-like projections radiating outward in an irregular, starburst pattern. The surface appears fibrous and rough, with the projections slightly curved and tapering at the tips.

Elongated, narrow, darkened streaks run parallel along the green leaf surface, appearing as thin, thread-like, slightly raised lines with smooth texture and subtle contrast against the healthy tissue.

Dense clusters of tall, slender, translucent stalks rise from dark, moist matter, each topped with a tiny, spherical yellow head. The stalks are straight to slightly curved, scattered among glossy black beetle-like shapes and green moss.

Small, scattered mushrooms with convex to flat, dark brown to grayish-brown caps, finely striate surfaces, and slightly paler centers. Thin, even margins and slender, dark brown to nearly black stems rise above mossy ground.
